conditions: PL/SQL identifier scope under local redeclaration in a subunit, using the distinction between scope and unqualified visibility.
limitations: The rule is scoped to identifiers of nested PL/SQL units. SQL query column resolution, synonyms, and privilege checks have separate rules.

triggers: Publisher revision, archived-byte drift, a documented qualifier, contrary source evidence or a controller change.

statement: Under the Oracle 19c reference, when a subunit redeclares a global identifier, both declarations remain in scope there and the local one is visible unqualified. The global declaration can be referenced by qualifying it with the declaring unit’s name, when that unit has a name.
